The root cause is that `src/checkout.js` sent the conversion event as `"Purchase"`, while the Flagsmith metric listens for `"purchase"`, so no conversion ever matched and both variants show 0 conversions (171 and 166 identities).

I changed it to `flagsmith.trackEvent("purchase")` in `src/checkout.js`. I didn't run the app or the experiment. The existing 337 enrolled identities will stay at 0 conversions, and only purchases made after you deploy will count.

The `flagsmith-experiment-doctor` skill failed to load, so I worked from `evidence.json` and the code directly.

The evidence also shows the flag has only a `green` variant defined, with no `control` entry, which may be worth checking in Flagsmith. It didn't cause the zero conversions.
